mentions.name: nailed
mentions.description: A generic PKCS#11 interface to Apple's Secure Enclave, enabling applications to use Secure Enclave keys through the standard PKCS#11 API. It was built primarily for use with OpenVPN and works like secretive or /usr/lib/ssh-keychain.dylib, but is not limited to SSH.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've built a generic PKCS#11 interface to the Apple's Secure Enclave[1]

Primarily to use in conjunction with OpenVPN. Like secretive or /usr/lib/ssh-keychain.dylib[2], but not just for SSH.
